== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster raises deploy to 4 and gives the ship a react that brings an Independent starship here. The original wording deploys the cruiser with the other ship as a react. The later attrition clause says Jabba here rather than aboard. Capacity, power, armor and hyperspeed remain.
